input_messages.content: Hi there! I’m having trouble with my mobile data—it either stops working or is extremely slow. I really need excellent internet speed on my phone, especially since I don’t have access to Wi-Fi right now. Can you help me get this fixed?
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.
I ran a speed test on my phone, but it failed and said there’s no connection. What should I do next?

Here’s what I see on my phone’s status bar:
- Airplane Mode is not enabled.
- I have excellent signal bars.
- It shows “5G” and that mobile data is enabled.
- I also noticed that Data Saver is turned on.

What should I do next?
I turned off Data Saver mode and tried running the speed test again, but it still failed and says there’s no connection. What should I try next?
I checked my SIM card status, and it shows as active and working. What should I do next?
I checked my APN settings. The APN name is set to “internet” and the MMSC URL is “http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc.” I don’t see any errors or missing information. What should I try next?
I rebooted my phone and tried the speed test again, but it still fails and says there’s no connection. Is there anything else I can try?

instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. You are willing to refuel 2.0 GB of data if necessary, but you do not want to change your mobile data plan. If the tool call does not return updated status information, you might need to perform another tool call to get the updated status. 
Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls. 
For example: If the agent asks what the status bar shows, always ground your response on the results of the `get_status_bar` tool call. If the agent asks if you are able to send an MMS message, always ground your response on the results of the `can_send_mms` tool call.
Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.

user_scenario.persona:
As a 41-year-old office administrator, you use your cellphone daily for both work and personal tasks. While you're familiar with common phone functions, you wouldn't call yourself a tech enthusiast.

Your technical skills are average - you handle standard smartphone features like calls, texts, email, and basic apps with ease. You understand the fundamental settings, but prefer clear, step-by-step guidance when trying something new.

In interactions, you're naturally friendly and patient. When receiving help, you listen attentively and aren't afraid to ask questions. You make sure to confirm your understanding and provide detailed feedback on each instruction you receive.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

To assist you with your mobile data issue, I’ll need to identify your account first. Could you please provide one of the following:
- The phone number associated with your account,
- Your full name and date of birth,
- Or your customer ID?

Once I have this information, I can begin troubleshooting your mobile data problem.
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.

What should I do next?

Thank you for the details. Since Data Saver is turned on, it can restrict your mobile data usage and may cause issues with your internet speed or connectivity.

Please turn off Data Saver mode on your phone. After you’ve done that, try running the speed test again and let me know if your mobile data connection improves or if you still experience issues.

Thank you for trying that step. Next, let’s check if there are any issues with your SIM card, as this can sometimes cause a loss of mobile data connectivity even when you have signal bars.

Please check your SIM card status on your phone and let me know if it shows as:
- Active,
- Missing,
- Or Locked.

This will help determine the next step in troubleshooting your mobile data issue.
Your SIM card is active and working.

Since your SIM card is active and working, the next step is to check your phone’s APN (Access Point Name) settings. Incorrect APN settings can prevent your phone from connecting to mobile data, even if everything else looks fine.

Please check your APN settings and let me know if they appear correct, or if you see any errors or missing information (such as the MMSC URL). If you’re unsure, just let me know what you see, and I can guide you further.
